roles.name: Ego
roles.description: A place-and-time pointer that traces the decision history shaped by Memory, Intellect, Sense, and Action.

roles.name: Intellect
roles.description: Strategy for reasoning, choosing methods, and organizing the next step.

roles.name: Sense
roles.description: Observation of the environment and internal operations.

roles.name: Action
roles.description: End-to-end orchestration that carries intent through execution.

note: A conceptual framework: Ego acts as a pen nib while temporal flow carries the decision history.
